description: Requires a connected plan (API key). Starts a Nombrio Naming Session: from a one-paragraph brief, generates up to 8 name ideas and pre-clears each with the same Clearance Check registries as check_name (US+EU+UK trademark, domains, social handles). Asynchronous — returns a sessionId; poll get_naming_session every ~10 s; typically 1–3 minutes. Uses one Naming Session from the plan (Clearance Report 10/30 days, Pro 30/month, Premium unlimited). Without a key it returns instructions to connect a plan.

brief.description: One paragraph: what the business/product/app does and for whom.

name: start_naming_session
title: Naming Session — 8 pre-cleared names from a brief (your plan)
